title: Socioeconomic Disparities in Privatized Pollution Remediation: Evidence from Toxic Chemical Spills
abstract: Governments often privatize the administration of regulations to third-party specialists paid for by the regulated parties. We study how the resulting conflict of interest can have unintended consequences for the distributional impacts of regulation. In Massachusetts, the party responsible for hazardous waste contamination must hire a licensed contractor to quantify the environmental severity. We find that contractors’ evaluations favor their clients, exhibiting substantial score bunching just below thresholds that determine government oversight of the remediation. Client favoritism is more pronounced in socioeconomically disadvantaged neighborhoods and is associated with inferior remediation quality, highlighting a novel channel for inequities in pollution exposure. (JEL D63, J15, K32, L51, Q53, R23)
abstract_zh: 政府常将法规的执行外包给由被监管方付费的第三方专业机构。我们研究由此产生的利益冲突，如何对监管的分配效应产生意料之外的后果。在马萨诸塞州，造成有害废物污染的责任方必须雇用持证承包商来量化环境危害的严重程度。我们发现，承包商的评估有利于其客户，在决定政府是否介入修复工作的阈值下方出现了明显的分数聚集。对客户的偏袒在社会经济条件处于劣势的社区中更为突出，并且与较差的修复质量相关，这凸显了污染暴露不平等的一个新渠道。（JEL D63, J15, K32, L51, Q53, R23）

title: Cleaner Waters and Urbanization
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Who Benefits from Surface Water Pollution Programs?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (under revision)
abstract: The Clean Water Act provides around 180 million dollars annually for nonpoint source pollution programs. We examine how state governments deploy these funds. We find that watersheds with wealthier and more white populations are less polluted but more likely to receive pollution project funding. Supporting analyses show that these disparities can be explained by spatial differences in local government capacity. Socioeconomically disadvantaged areas have fewer resources to compete for grants and constrained match funding for grant proposal requirements. Our findings suggest that a competitive application process is an inequitable way to determine environmental funding priorities and could amplify justice concerns.
abstract_zh: 《清洁水法》每年为非点源污染治理项目提供约1.8亿美元资金。我们考察各州政府如何使用这些资金。我们发现，财富水平较高、白人人口比例较高的流域污染较轻，但更有可能获得污染治理项目资金。辅助分析表明，这些差异可以由各地方政府能力的空间差异来解释。社会经济条件处于劣势的地区，争取拨款的资源较少，且难以筹措拨款申请所要求的配套资金。我们的研究结果表明，竞争性申请程序是一种不公平的环境资金优先级确定方式，可能加剧正义问题。

title: Conditional Cash Lotteries Increase COVID-19 Vaccination Rates
Mandatory Energy Efficiency Disclosure in Housing Markets
abstract: Mandatory disclosure policies are implemented broadly despite sparse evidence that they improve market outcomes. We study the effects of requiring home sellers to provide buyers with certified audits of residential energy efficiency. Using similar nearby homes as a comparison group, we find that this requirement increases price premiums for energy efficiency and encourages energy-saving investments. We additionally present evidence highlighting the market failure—incomplete information by both buyers and sellers—that prevents widespread voluntary disclosure of energy efficiency in housing transactions. Our findings support that disclosure policies can improve market outcomes in settings with symmetrically incomplete information. (JEL D83, K32, L98, Q41, Q48, R31)
abstract_zh: 强制性信息披露政策被广泛实施，尽管几乎没有证据表明它们能够改善市场结果。我们研究了要求房主向买方提供住宅能效认证审计报告的效果。以附近相似住宅作为对照组，我们发现该要求提高了能效的价格溢价，并促进了节能投资。我们还提供证据，说明市场失灵——买卖双方信息不完全——阻碍了住房交易中能效信息的广泛自愿披露。我们的研究结果支持这样一种观点：在信息对称不完全的环境中，信息披露政策可以改善市场结果。（JEL D83, K32, L98, Q41, Q48, R31）

title: What Do Residential Lotteries Show Us About Transportation Choices?
Automated Enforcement of Irrigation Regulations and Social Pressure for Water Conservation
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This study evaluates two interventions for residential water conservation. Comparing households across an enforcement algorithm's cutoff using a regression discontinuity design, we find that automated irrigation violation warnings cause substantial water conservation but also shift some consumption from regulated to unregulated hours within the week. In contrast, we show using data from a randomized experiment with the same customers that normative Home Water Reports reduce water use by a much smaller amount, but that this social pressure is effective during all hours both before and after automating irrigation policy enforcement. Our findings highlight the merits of implementing multidimensional conservation programs.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了两项居民节水干预措施。利用断点回归设计，比较执法算法阈值两侧的家庭，我们发现自动化灌溉违规警告带来了显著的节水效果，但也使部分用水从受规管时段转移到了同一周内未受规管的时段。相比之下，我们利用同一批客户的随机实验数据表明，具有规范性质的家庭用水报告（Home Water Reports）所减少的用水量要小得多，但这种社会压力在灌溉政策自动化执法实施之前和之后的所有时段均有效。我们的研究结果凸显了实施多维度节水计划的优点。

title: Cash for Corollas: When Stimulus Reduces Spending
Vehicle Miles (Not) Traveled: Fuel Economy Requirements, Vehicle Characteristics, and Household Driving
Effects of the Minimum Wage on Employment Dynamics
Efficient Retail Pricing in Electricity and Natural Gas Markets
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: A long line of research investigates whether the retail prices of electricity and natural gas send proper signals about scarcity in order to induce efficient consumption. Historically, regulated utilities have not designed tariffs that set marginal prices equal to marginal costs. Currently, some jurisdictions are opening the retail sectors to competition via “retail choice.” These new regimes replace imperfect regulation with imperfect competition as the process by which retail tariffs are formed. We discuss the challenges in evaluating the efficiency of tariffs and present evidence of how pricing has changed in markets with retail choice.
abstract_zh: 长期以来，大量研究探讨电力和天然气的零售价格是否发出了关于稀缺性的恰当信号，以诱导有效率的消费。历史上，受管制的公用事业公司并未设计出使边际价格等于边际成本的电价方案。目前，部分司法辖区正通过“零售选择”（retail choice）向竞争开放零售市场。这些新制度以不完全竞争取代了不完全管制，成为零售电价的形成过程。我们讨论了评估电价效率所面临的挑战，并提供了零售选择市场中定价如何变化的证据。
